'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Chris Haglund DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Haglund]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|Knowledge And Defense (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
